name: Chesa Arella
beschreibung:
Apartmenthaus Chesa Arella welcomes guests to the traffic-calmed alpine paradise of Serfaus. Decorated with natural materials and keen attention to detail, the residences provide contemporary comfort for families and couples.

The celebrated mountain lifts of Serfaus-Fiss-Ladis and the village underground station are within minutes, granting seamless access to skiing and hiking.
kurzbeschreibung: Chesa Arella in Serfaus offers stylish holiday apartments on the sunny high plateau for a memorable family holiday.
